review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 240 files: 159 under Linglib/Syntax and 81 under Linglib/Phonology; every file owns declarations and 192 files contain 1,907 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The syntax side includes Minimalist, categorial, HPSG, construction/dependency/word grammar, case and agreement frameworks; the phonology side includes subregular, autosegmental, optimality-theoretic, harmonic-grammar, prosodic and tone formalisms.
Path names such as Demonstrative are linguistic technical vocabulary rather than demo/test markers; no reviewed subtree is disposable scaffolding.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib syntax/phonology unit as substantive formal grammar and phonological theory.
